comment: Owned by the license review. Third-party JavaScript that cmux-browser-host embeds (build.rs include_str! of every file that cmux-tui/crates/cmux-browser-host/js/manifest.json lists). One row per file of js/vendor; marker is a regex the file must match (it pins the reviewed upstream version). texts: keys of `texts`, stored verbatim from the upstream npm tarball. browser_host_js_notices.py fails a vendor file without a row, a stale row, a row the manifest does not embed, a marker or sha256 mismatch, a non-vendor runtime file that names third-party origin, and a hand-written.md section that lacks a path or a text.
